responsibility: Provides the x86 CET shadow-stack intrinsic interface associated with the SHSTK feature. It conditionally enables shstk and exposes inline wrappers for reading and adjusting the shadow-stack pointer, saving/restoring SSP state, writing shadow-stack memory, and managing busy markers, mapping those user-visible intrinsics onto GCC’s CET builtins for both 32-bit and 64-bit modes.
